move_semantics: assignment, parameter passing, and return transfer one owner
allocation: target-provided allocator with explicit constructors and exact reserve
aliasing: multiple shared borrows or one mutable borrow; no machine noalias promise
borrow_lifetime: lexical block or temporary call duration
text_indexing: no direct code-point indexing in M1.39
text_slice: owned copy at UTF-8 code-point boundaries
error_model: compile-time ownership/borrow diagnostics and deterministic runtime traps
ir_representation: one logical typed owned buffer value with private descriptor and ownership state
ssa_move_model: linear owner state; identical ownership availability at joins and loop backedges
runtime_layout: private storage identity plus i64 length and i64 capacity
native_abi: internal S3 descriptor order base,length,capacity under aggregate/sret mechanism
ffi_view: borrowed base address plus i64 length
destruction: compiler-inserted deterministic drop at lexical exits
records_arrays_enums: owned bytes/text nesting deferred from M1.39
determinism: addresses and allocation tokens non-semantic; exact capacity; explicit limits; no implicit growth
cross_module: owned and borrowed bytes/text allowed in S3 function parameters and returns
m140_boundary: closed numeric dynamic collections and growth policy
